messages.subject: exporting to bioconductor
parts:
Thanks for all your previous help...i think i might need some more. I
have now successfully calculated the chip effects and am stuck trying
to extract the data as an exprSet object... see below:
>cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20071112,EP")
>cs2 <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("PC3DataSet-C4", cdf=cdf)
>bc2 <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs2, tag="BCcoreCDF")
>csBC2 <- process(bc2,verbose=verbose)
>qn2 <- QuantileNormalization(csBC2, typesToUpdate="pm",tags="QNcore")
>csN2 <- process(qn2)
>plmTr2 <- ExonRmaPlm(csN2, mergeGroups=TRUE)
>fit(plmTr2, verbose=verbose)
>chp<-getChipEffectSet(plmTr2)
>es<-extractExprSet(chp)
Error: could not find function "extractExprSet"

It's probably very silly question but i don't know what i'm doing
wrong. I tried exporting as a matrix and i think it worked...
Thanks,
Maria

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] exporting to bioconductor
parts:
Hi Maria,
I don't think such a function exists. You can extract the data into a
matrix (numbers only) or into a data frame (includes information
regarding the group and unit that the rows corrspond to, see the example
on the help pages). You would then need to manually convert that into
the proper format to be an exprSet.
Best,
Elizabeth

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: exporting to bioconductor
parts:
Hi Maria,
 
This is really a question that belongs on the Bioconductor list.  However, please note from the help for lmFit() of limma that the "object" argument for that function may be
 
"object of class numeric, matrix, MAList, marrayNorm, ExpressionSet or PLMset containing log-ratios or log-values of expression for a series of microarrays"
 
So there is no need for you to convert the matrix - you can use it directly.  You will of course have to set up an appropriate design matrix and so on.  The limma package has excellent documentation (?limma) with examples, or you can ask on the BioC list if you are having trouble.
 
Hope this helps,
 
Ken

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: exporting to bioconductor
parts:
Hi Maria,

If you want to associate the probe set/transcript/gene IDs with the matrix, why not just set the rownames attribute of the matrix?  e.g.

em <- extractMatrix(chp)
un <- getUnitNames(cdf)
rownames(em) <- un

If I remember correctly, functions in limma will use the rownames of the matrix if they are there when generating topTables and so on.

Cheers,

Ken
